name: The Old Course, St Andrews
architects: unknown origins (golf played on the links since the 15th century); shaped by Allan Robertson (1840s-50s, the double greens) and Old Tom Morris (from 1865: the 1st and 18th greens)

dtm.source: Scottish Public Sector LiDAR Phase 5, 50 cm DTM, tiles NO41NE and NO51NW (EPSG:27700, ODN heights), mosaicked and clipped to the world + 100 m by data/st_andrews_old/mosaic_lidar.py; srsp-open-data (registry.opendata.aws/scottish-lidar), Open Government Licence v3; fetched by the GitHub Actions fetch workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-st_andrews_old)

dsm.source: Scottish Public Sector LiDAR Phase 5, 50 cm DSM, tiles NO41NE and NO51NW, as the DTM

world.note: OSM Old Course boundary way/1019045811 bbox (1,445 x 2,007 m) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 1,792 m east-west (174 m each side), 2,048 m north-south (20 m each side: the 2,048 m limit, COURSE_BUILD.md 6.1)

scorecard_source: St Andrews Links Old Course scorecard 2026 (PDF supplied by the developer, 2026-11-13; also the hole-by-hole pages of standrews.com, screenshots from the developer): Black 6,670 / Blue 6,355 / Green 6,044 yd, par 72 (men), men's stroke index, men's ratings 73.4/136, 71.8/133, 70.2/127 (women's Green 76.5/140, par 76). The card's pars 4/5 (holes 2, 4, 13, 17) are men/women. The older card on third-party sites (White 6,721) is superseded.
